title: Paint Blocks
description: Minecraft mod that let's you paint your world!
body:
# Paint Blocks

Paint Blocks is a Minecraft mod that allows players to draw directly onto blocks in their world and create custom paintings using an in-game canvas system.

## Features

- Draw directly onto blocks in your Minecraft world
- Create and place custom paintings
- Simple in-game painting controls
- Multiplayer compatible
- Survival and creative mode support

## Requirements

This mod requires the following dependencies:

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

Please make sure both dependencies are installed before launching the game.

## How to Use

- Press the `P` key to enter Paint Mode
- Place a `Canvas` block to create a custom painting
- Use the painting tools in-game to draw and edit artwork

## Support & Feedback
